subject: Solara reorg — pause LLM pilot / demo on standby
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@solara.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@solara.io>
Date: 2026-10-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request to postpone next week’s demo — Solara LLM pilot

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the agenda and the mutual action plan. I wanted to flag that our leadership just completed a short roadmapping sprint and the LLM inference pilot is being deprioritized for the remainder of the year while we focus on a payments integration and a regulatory audit. Two of our lead infra engineers will be traveling for client workshops the next three weeks, so we won’t have capacity to run the pilot or attend the demo next Tuesday.

Could we pause the demo and revisit in early January? If helpful, please send a short recording of the walkthrough and a one-page pricing summary so our procurement team has something to review while we reorg. I’ve attached an updated timeline for our internal RFP to show the new window.

Apologies for the late notice — this came out of an exec alignment call this morning.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Director, Product Operations
Solara Analytics

[Attachment: RFP_timeline.pdf (PDF)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@solara.io>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@solara.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-10T12:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to postpone next week’s demo — Solara LLM pilot

Hi Alicia — thanks for the heads up and congrats on finishing the sprint. Totally understand the bandwidth and travel constraints.

We can absolutely pause the live demo. A couple quick items so we’re aligned:
- I’ll record a 20–25 minute walkthrough of the demo and share the video + slides by Friday.
- I’ll attach a short pricing one-pager and our mutual action plan draft so procurement has something concrete to review while you’re reorganizing.
- Would you prefer we tentatively slot a follow-up for the week of Jan 11 or Jan 18? We can set a tentative placeholder and I’ll convert to a confirmed calendar invite once you’re ready.

If it helps, Marissa (cc’d) can run a 15-minute internal technical sync with your infra leads once they’re back from travel — just to keep momentum with minimal overhead.

I’ve attached the draft MAP for your team to scan. If you want any specific TCO numbers up front let me know and I’ll prioritize those.

Thanks — we’ll stand by and be flexible.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

[Attachment: mutual_action_plan-draft.docx (DOCX)]

From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@solara.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@solara.io>
Cc: procurement@solara.io
Date: 2026-10-11T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to postpone next week’s demo — Solara LLM pilot

Hannah — quick note from our side: this is a company-level reprioritization, not just a product team request. The exec team asked us to deprioritize all new pilots that require infra changes until our Q1 roadmap work is finished.

Given that, can you cancel the upcoming calendar invite and we’ll reach back out in January? In the meantime, please send a short pricing deck and any notes on dedicated vs hosted deployments (we want to understand cost and data residency choices while we plan). If there’s a single number or ballpark that helps procurement triage, that would be appreciated.

I’ve cc’d procurement so they have context. We’ll open a new intake once the roadmap window reopens.

Thanks,
Tom Nguyen
VP, Engineering
Solara Analytics

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@solara.io>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@solara.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request to postpone next week’s demo — Solara LLM pilot

Thanks Tom — understoood and appreciate the clarity. I’ve canceled the live demo on our side and set a tentative reminder to reconnect the week of 2027-01-15 (I put a note in the HubSpot deal).

Attachments I’m sending now:
- redwood-one-pager.pdf (high-level pricing and deployment options)
- link to the MAP draft in Drive (for Alicia’s team)

Marissa and Vivek — please note: flag RD-7421 for a Q1 outreach. Marissa, can you take point on pricing follow-up and a short TCO that compares Hosted vs Dedicated for a 6–12 month pilot? Vivek, if you can draft a 2-slide infra checklist for Solara’s procurement that outlines integration prerequisites, that will make restart easier.

Alicia/Tom — we’ll leave the thread open and will await your note in January. If anything shifts sooner, ping me and we’ll move quicker.

Best,
— Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.ai
